about: How each treaty partner, as GOV.UK titles it, is placed on the world map. A partner that is exactly a country name in the map (world-atlas 2.0.2, from Natural Earth) needs no entry. Every other partner must appear below: as one or more map countries (aliases), as an organisation (not drawn), or as a state that no longer exists (not drawn). A partner in none of these fails the build.

why.Ireland/EC: Ireland is the only state party; the European Community is an organisation.
why.Sweden [Iran]: The title names Sweden as the treaty partner, acting in respect of Iran.
why.SACU and Mozambique: The Southern African Customs Union's members are Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho, Namibia and South Africa.
why.FR Germany: The Federal Republic of Germany is Germany's official name, before and after 1990.

organisations: Secretariat of UN Framework Convention on Climate Change, Kyoto Protocol and Paris Agreement
